en.title: World3D clock restarts after a long stop
en.body: The World3D display loop re-anchors an oversized first frame after restarting on the same Engine, preserving elapsed gameplay time and resuming on the next frame.

zh.title: 修复 World3D 长时间停止后的时钟重启
zh.body: 在同一引擎上重启 World3D 显示循环时，首帧间隔超限会重新设定时钟锚点，保留已累计的游戏时间并在下一帧恢复更新。
